name: zmodel_const_add_or_merge_vertex_and_normal
description: zModel_Const::AddOrMergeVertexAndNormal merges exact point plus blend-normal delta pairs into the zDi vertex and blend-vertex arrays.
known_limits: Functional acceptance covers the exact-match merge and append paths. tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zModel AddPolygonEx source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x482860 validates the fastcall ABI with self in ecx, point in edx, normal on the stack, and return of the existing or appended vertex index, or -1 after the warning path.

Binary Ninja assembly validates exact x87 equality comparisons for point coordinates and the stored blend-normal delta computed as normal - point, realloc growth of self->verts and self->blendVerts, and mirroring self->blendVertCount to self->vertCount after append.
Binary Ninja data at 0x4d2ab8 validates the recovered vertex warning threshold as the double value 921.6, and string data at 0x4e162c and 0x4e1604 validates the warning message shape.
The native smoke verifies first append, exact duplicate merge without count growth, and same-point/different-delta append through the production arrays.
